> Orion is built **phase-by-phase**, favoring the simplest thing that works (see
> [`plans/orion-plan.md`](../../plans/orion-plan.md) for the roadmap and
> [`docs/known-issues.md`](../../docs/known-issues.md) for ideas already on record).
> Features are weighed against simplicity and current scope — a good request explains
> the underlying need so the right-sized solution can be chosen, and a deliberately
> deferred idea is a valid outcome.

## The problem / use case

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? Describe the need, not just
the feature — it helps find the simplest fit.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like Orion to do. Rough is fine.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve this, including workarounds you already tried or whether an existing
Orion feature nearly covers it.

## Scope and fit

Anything you know about how this fits Orion's phase order, its local-first / minimal-
dependency goals, or its cross-platform requirement (Linux, macOS, Windows). If it
relates to an existing item in [`docs/known-issues.md`](../../docs/known-issues.md),
link it.
